messages:
elena: seeing a handshake spike in ap-south starting ~11:57 UTC, lots of ECONNRESET and 'kms unwrap denied' in the proxy logs. Fallbacks kicked in and we served TLS1.2 for some sessions. @kai did the RBAC tighten land yesterday? :eyes:

audit-bot: policy-change deploy: PR #4821 merged by kai at 02:00 UTC. Modified iam:Decrypt scope for role 'svc-edge-keystore' (removed cross-region wildcard).

kai: yeah that was my change to limit Decrypt to region-specific principals. I thought all proxies had explicit region roles. i didn't expect the edge-proxy service account to be missing the scoped grant. i can check now.

mike: paste of the error snippets from proxy (ap-south):
```
ERROR proxy/handshake: 2026-03-21T11:57:03Z handshake failed: kms unwrap denied for key arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:123456789:key/abcd-ef01 role=svc-edge-keystore svc=proxy-edge-ap-south
WARN proxy/fallback: client negotiated TLSv1.2 AES_128_GCM (fallback) for conn_id=xyz
```

elena: interestingly, cloud audit logs show AccessDenied entries around the same time but we don't see a KMS:Decrypt API entry with the key ARN. sampling might have dropped it. that gaps detection. we need an immediate rollback for the svc-edge-keystore binding in ap-south and a short postmortem.

kai: rolling back the specific grant for svc-edge-keystore in ap-south now. applying change to infra repo and kicking canary deploy.

lina: proposed mitigation plan: 1) rollback RBAC for svc-edge-keystore in ap-south only (done as quick rollback) 2) patch edge-proxy to fail-closed on KMS unwrap (no TLS fallback) as an interim (config flag) 3) increase sampling / retention for KMS unwrap audit logs in ap-south 4) add an infra smoke that exercises unwrap and validates audit entry 5) run canary for 15m before full rollout. :lock:

elena: +1. also add a short-term alert to detect when a keystore role loses Decrypt permission (preflight). that would've caught this in staging. i'll own the postmortem.

kai: rollback applied and recorded. monitoring shows handshake errors dropping back toward baseline within ~60s of rollback. PR to make scoped allow explicit coming up: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4990 (draft).

audit-bot: rollback recorded by kai. event_id: abcd-1234. cluster=ap-south-1, affected_service=proxy-edge.

mike: traffic stabilized but we had ~3 minutes of degraded handshakes and ~0.8% client retries on active flows. incident ticket created: SEC-2026-031. we'll do customer outreach if SLA thresholds exceeded.

elena: follow-ups for the postmortem: - timeline and root cause (RBAC change removed Decrypt for the exact service principal) - detection gap (KMS audit sampling + missing unwrap logs) - mitigations (rollback, fail-closed flag, forced TLS1.3 opt-in path) - action items: add unwrap+audit e2e test, preflight RBAC smoke on deploys, telemetry to detect TLS fallback to <1.3, and revisit KMS audit sampling config in ap-south.

kai: i'll add automation: any PR that touches keystore RBAC will trigger a preflight that runs unwrap smoke for dependent services (edge-proxy, ingress, auth). also adding a note in the rollout playbook to canary RBAC in a single region first.

lina: note: enforcing TLS1.3 cluster-wide will break some older clients. we should stage the TLS1.3 enforcement behind a header-based opt-in or route-level config and track rejection telemetry before wide rollout.

elena: @audit-bot can you paste the query we should use to fetch KMS unwrap entries? i'm not finding the matching record in stackdriver during the incident window.

audit-bot: recommended query (Stackdriver BigQuery style):
```
resource.type="gce_instance" AND
protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com" AND
(protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" OR protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt") AND
timestamp >= "2026-03-21T11:50:00Z" AND timestamp <= "2026-03-21T12:10:00Z" AND
labels.region="ap-south-1"
```

elena: thanks. will run that and attach results to the postmortem.

mike: can we add a short-term rule: if a keystore role loses Decrypt in an active region, create a pager if edge-proxy error rate > 0.1% within 5m? we had silent blips.

lina: agreed. add a severity for keystore unwrap denies.

elena: postmortem draft will include: owner=kai for RBAC change, owner=elena for detection & tests, owner=lina for TLS rollout plan, owner=mike for SRE follow-up. ETA for postmortem: EOD tomorrow.

kai: sorry for the blast radius. i'll be more conservative with cross-region decrypt restrictions and ensure preflight smoke runs. :bow:
